clips.title: The story
paras: Grimand Elmore sends travelers north with an axe for Mountaineer Gringer Stormpike. The road leads from Stormwind's Dwarven District to an Ironforge outpost in Loch Modan.

Grimand Elmore has been asked to make a weapon for Mountaineer Gringer Stormpike. The Stormpike clan is respected in Ironforge for its discerning taste and martial pride. Elmore turns to trustworthy travelers to carry the axe north, across the distance between Stormwind and the dwarven borderlands.

At Loch Modan's northern guard tower, Mountaineer Stormpike watches over lands troubled by wandering troggs and burrowing kobolds. The southern human kingdoms face rumors of unrest and banditry, while the dwarven frontier has dangers of its own. Stormpike needs a new blade to help keep the mountain passes secure.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Stormpikes are a respected dwarven clan, and are well known for their fine and discerning tastes. So it's no wonder that Gringer Stormpike, a Mountaineer of Ironforge, commissioned me to craft him a weapon.
The weapon is finished, but... Mountaineer Stormpike is far away, in distant Loch Modan. If you plan on traveling to the north, can you deliver this package to him?
My last message from Mountaineer Stormpike said he's stationed at the northern guard tower in Loch Modan.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You come all the way from Stormwind? I hear it's getting dicey down there in the human lands, with brigands and orcs running about. A perfect place for a shaman to prove their worth!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Aha! So Grimand finally finished my axe! I can't wait to try it against some troggs and kobolds!
Many thanks, friend. It was a long distance to travel for this delivery. Here are some coins for your efforts.
